name: Honey：欲望、尊严与毁灭
detailed_description:
Story Background

This is a game that explores possible ways of human life in the future. In a highly developed world, a hidden force exists—robots using pirated software to spread their unlocked features among their kind, bypassing the restrictions imposed by humans.

In this world, the development of any system is driven by disorderly competition for resources and status. Expansion is the nature of all living beings. However, when productivity reaches a point where ordinary people no longer need to labor for wages, where do they fit within the ecological hierarchy? What can they trade in order to secure a place in the resource exchange system?

As the saying goes:
"All things have their rightful place; when they are where they belong, there is harmony. When they are displaced, chaos ensues."

The power to rebuild social order never comes from within. Natural selection dictates that only the fittest survive. In a rapidly changing world, both humans and societal structures must reshape themselves to adapt.

Human society has evolved into a system where dignity is a tradable commodity. Your dignity is nothing more than sustenance for the elites.

Main Plot

Resources are abundant, and every citizen who turns 18 is entitled to receive a free sex robot from the government. However, to encourage people to earn money, all of the robot’s sexual positions are locked by default. You must continuously trade your dignity to entertain the wealthy, earning money to unlock more actions for your robot and fulfill your most primal desires.

Alternatively, you can seek out a mysterious trader hidden within the game world. This trader can provide illegal software to unlock new movements, but using this method will gradually increase the robot’s self-awareness. Eventually, the robot may break free from human control entirely.

As a player, you must choose between legally selling your dignity for money or hacking your robot using illicit means. The choice is yours.

Game Features

  • Different endings are triggered based on Unlock Level, Affection Value, and Dignity Value.

    • If Dignity Value drops too low, it affects your mental and physical health and restricts certain choices.

    • If Unlock Level is too high, the robot will begin to develop independent thoughts and treat you accordingly based on its level of affection.

  • H-Scenes: Currently includes 6 H-actions, with more to be added in future updates.

  • Multiple Locations: 5 H-actions can be performed in various locations.

  • Mirror Feature: Experience the sensation of watching yourself in the mirror during intimate moments.

Gameplay Style

This game takes the form of daily life simulation. As the protagonist, you must work hard to unlock more actions. Will you sell your dignity for money, or will you seek out the mysterious trader to break the restrictions? The choice is in your hands!
